records.title: Collector must not terminally grade un-launched starved runs
records.description: collect_harness_run must not assign a terminal state to a manifest entry with state="PENDING" and pid is None that is within its _pending_deadline_s() window. Source: bin/harness/plan_runner.py:2606 (collect_harness_run submit loop) and bin/harness/plan_runner.py:2082-2146 (_collect_one_run_detached orphan-poll, where pid is None routes to FAILED).

records.title: Every detached-spawn path must record the real PID
records.description: Any code that calls inflight_registry.acquire_run_slot and then spawns a run must call update_pid with the launched PID before returning. Compliant: bin/harness/plan_runner.py:3078 (_wrapped). Non-compliant: bin/harness/plan_runner.py:2530 (_retry_pending_runs_once).

records.title: A relaunched PENDING entry must transition out of PENDING
records.description: After a successful retry relaunch, the manifest entry's state must reflect RUNNING (not remain PENDING). Source: bin/harness/plan_runner.py:2538 (_retry_pending_runs_once merge); the returned dict at bin/harness/plan_runner.py:1844-1872 (_launch_one_run_detached) carries no state key.

records.title: Phase inference must report the highest phase actually completed, never higher
records.description: status._infer_phase_from_artifacts must key each phase on an artifact the runner treats as that phase's exclusive boundary marker. Source: bin/harness/status.py:285-316 (_PHASE_ARTIFACTS) vs bin/run_playbook.py:1522-1523 (Phase-4 prerequisite gate listing QUALITY.md/COMPLETENESS_REPORT.md as Phase-2 outputs).

records.title: pid=0 reservations must not become permanent phantom slots
records.description: A pid=0 registry entry must always carry a parseable started_at so the 300s age-out applies, or _entry_is_active must age out malformed-timestamp reservations. Source: bin/harness/inflight_registry.py:343-348 (_entry_is_active).

records.title: Per-provider concurrency cap must be honored across all spawn paths
records.description: The count of active runs per provider must never exceed max_per_provider[provider] (or plan_pool_cap). Source: bin/harness/inflight_registry.py:448-470 (acquire_run_slot).

records.title: Collector idempotency must require a consistent receipt set
records.description: The grading.json-present short-circuit must also verify facts.json consistency for COMPLETED runs before returning a cached outcome. Source: bin/harness/plan_runner.py:2015-2052 (_collect_one_run_detached idempotency block).

records.title: Supervisor terminal-status writes must win over collector inference
records.description: When status.json already carries a terminal_state, the collector must not overwrite it. Source: bin/harness/plan_runner.py:2306-2312 (_write_terminal_status, currently compliant — must stay so).

records.title: Install validator must require explicit AI tool on ambiguity and a fresh marker for a populated quality/
records.description: qpb_validate must block when multiple AI-tool markers exist without --ai-tool, and must treat a populated quality/ with no recent run_start as stale. Source: bin/qpb_validate.py:1272 (check_stale_quality_dir) and marker resolution.

records.title: Council roster resolution must degrade safely and target three members
records.description: council_members() must fall back to DEFAULT_COUNCIL_MEMBERS on any malformed config and, per the Council-of-Three design, the effective roster should comprise three members. Source: bin/council_config.py:47-110; reference_docs/22_council_of_three.md.

records.title: Archival must not silently overwrite or hard-abort on a recoverable collision
records.description: archive_run must refuse to overwrite an existing archive (compliant) but should disambiguate a same-second timestamp collision rather than aborting the run. Source: bin/archive_lib.py:821-826 (archive_run).

records.title: Source-edit guard must flag any non-quality/ mutation at run end
records.description: validate_no_source_edits must report any tracked or untracked path outside allowed prefixes as a violation at run end. Source: bin/run_state_lib.py:976 (validate_no_source_edits); rename field-order verified destination-first.
